verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments platform, so full data export and portability is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the pack documents exporting all account data in open formats. Dashboard reports (docs-24) are not described as exportable or in any file format, and data migration (docs-33) covers importing data into Finix, not taking it out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
